items.title: Summary of Budget Hearing Questions
items.text: Summary of Budget Hearing Questions GM Herrera provided response to a question asked at the last meeting regarding contracting and staff vacancies, stating that there is no correlation between the two and that consultants are not replacing civil service staff, but are that at most augmenting SFPUC staff and only for specific approved reasons. He reviewed process for contracting out work, stating it is a well- defined and public process, with notice to labor partners, with numbers show it is used sparingly
